notes.title: FONO’S FINAL RELEASE IS LIVE
notes.content:
It’s DONE! It only took two years of hard work and good fun. But now, without a further ado, let us tell you about everything that’s new in this final, complete, ultimate version of the game! 

But first — good news everyone! Three announcements:

[h2]FINAL RELEASE[/h2]
This is Fono’s final release. More updates may come in the future but for now, we’re pretty happy with the game and consider it complete. We hope you’ll enjoy it at least as much as we enjoyed making it.  

[h2]COMUNITY FEEDBACK[/h2]
We have listened to your feedback and we incorporated many improvements, better level designs and couple of new longer levels. Again, we’ll be incredibly thankful for any feedback you can give us.

[h2]NEW PROJECT IN PROGRESS[/h2]
We cannot wait to tell you about our new project. It’s silly, it’s stupid, and we’re going to broadcast the hell out of it. If you want to see how a bunch of guys develop a game almost in real time, follow us on FB, IG or Reddit.

[h2]WHAT’S NEW IN THE FINAL RELEASE OF FONO?[/h2]

[list]
[*] NEW LEVELS: 7 new levels with physics puzzles, platforms and other goodies.
[*] NEW LOBBY: easier to choose a level and interactive music
[*] NEW GAME INTRO: moar particleees
[*] SOUNDTRACK: you can check it out on Spotify, Youtube or even here on Steam.
[*] STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS: of course
[*] SPEEDRUN: https://fono.ninja is redesigned, new stats, search function, etc.
[*] EYE CANDY: bunch of other eye candy stuff hidden in levels (worth exploring again
[/list]
